connectorUiConfig.title: QCrypton PQC VPN Overlay (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The QCrypton PQC VPN Overlay data connector ingests tunnel telemetry from hybrid post-quantum WireGuard instances into Microsoft Sentinel through the QCrypton API. PQC VPN Overlay extends WireGuard with ML-KEM-768 key encapsulation and ML-DSA-65 digital signatures, providing quantum-resistant tunnels with backward compatibility. This connector streams tunnel lifecycle events, policy enforcement decisions, classical fallback warnings, and HNDL risk indicators into the PQCVPNOverlay_CL table.

graphQueries.metricName: Total VPN tunnel telemetry events received

sampleQueries.description: PQC tunnel adoption rate in the last 24h
sampleQueries.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where EventType_s == 'tunnel_up'
| summarize PQC = countif(PQCUsed_d == 1), Classical = countif(PQCUsed_d == 0)
| extend PQCPct = round(100.0 * PQC / (PQC + Classical), 1)
| project PQC, Classical, PQCPct

PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where EventType_s == 'policy_block'
| project TimeGenerated, PeerID_s, PeerAddress_s, KeyExchange_s, PolicyMode_s, ErrorMessage_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: HNDL risk assessment across active tunnels
sampleQueries.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where EventType_s == 'tunnel_up'
| summarize Protected = countif(HNDLRisk_d == 0), AtRisk = countif(HNDLRisk_d == 1) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart

PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where EventType_s == 'classical_fallback'
| project TimeGenerated, PeerID_s, PeerAddress_s, KeyExchange_s, PolicyMode_s, HNDLRisk_d
| order by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: PQCVPNOverlay_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

instructionSteps.title: Connect QCrypton PQC VPN Overlay to Microsoft Sentinel

parameters.content: This connector polls the QCrypton PQC VPN Overlay API to retrieve hybrid post-quantum WireGuard tunnel telemetry and ingest it into the **PQCVPNOverlay_CL** table in your Log Analytics workspace.

#### 1. API Key
Obtain your QCrypton API key (starts with `qk-`) from the [QCrypton Portal](https://portal.qcrypton.com). Navigate to **Settings > API Keys** and generate a key with read access to VPN tunnel telemetry.

#### 2. API Server URL
Enter the base URL of your QCrypton API server. The default is `https://api.qcrypton.com`. If you use a dedicated or regional instance, enter the URL provided by QCrypton.

parameters.label: QCrypton API Server URL
parameters.name: apiServerUrl
parameters.description: Enter the QCrypton API base URL. Do not include a trailing slash or path.

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: Event type: tunnel_up, tunnel_down, tunnel_rekey, handshake_fail, policy_block, policy_warn, classical_fallback, peer_discovered.

columns.name: KeyExchange
columns.description: Key exchange algorithm: X25519+ML-KEM-768 or X25519.

columns.name: PolicyMode
columns.description: Policy mode: require, prefer, allow, disable.

properties.description: VPNHandshakeFailure_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

A hybrid post-quantum WireGuard handshake failed. This may indicate key material incompatibility
between peers, ML-KEM key encapsulation failure, network-level interference with the Noise IK
handshake, or a peer running an incompatible PQC VPN Overlay version. Investigate the error
message and peer address. Repeated failures from the same peer may indicate an attack or
misconfiguration.
properties.displayName: PQC VPN tunnel handshake failure
properties.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventType_s == "handshake_fail"
| project TimeGenerated, PeerID_s, PeerAddress_s, KeyExchange_s, PolicyMode_s, ErrorMessage_s, Metadata_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc

properties.description: QCryptonPQCVPNOverlay Analytics Rule 1

properties.displayName: PQC VPN tunnel handshake failure

properties.description: VPNPolicyBlock_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

The PQC VPN Overlay policy engine blocked a peer connection. This occurs when PQCPolicy is set
to "require" and a peer does not support hybrid post-quantum key exchange. The peer attempted to
establish a classical WireGuard tunnel but was rejected because the policy mandates PQC
protection. Either upgrade the remote peer to support ML-KEM-768 or change the policy to
"prefer" to allow classical fallback.
properties.displayName: PQC VPN policy blocked a connection
properties.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventType_s == "policy_block"
| project TimeGenerated, PeerID_s, PeerAddress_s, KeyExchange_s, PolicyMode_s, PolicyAction_s, ErrorMessage_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc

properties.description: QCryptonPQCVPNOverlay Analytics Rule 2

properties.displayName: PQC VPN policy blocked a connection

properties.description: ClassicalFallbackDetected_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

A WireGuard tunnel was established using classical X25519 key exchange because the remote peer
does not support ML-KEM-768 hybrid key exchange. The PQC policy was set to "prefer" or "allow",
so the connection was permitted but is NOT protected against harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks.
All traffic through this tunnel can be recorded and decrypted by a future quantum computer.
Upgrade the remote peer to support PQC VPN Overlay.
properties.displayName: Classical fallback — PQC VPN tunnel established without quantum protection
properties.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventType_s == "classical_fallback"
| project TimeGenerated, PeerID_s, PeerAddress_s, KeyExchange_s, PolicyMode_s, HNDLRisk_d, Metadata_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc

properties.description: QCryptonPQCVPNOverlay Analytics Rule 3

properties.displayName: Classical fallback — PQC VPN tunnel established without quantum protection

properties.description: HighHNDLRiskRate_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

More than 30% of active PQC VPN tunnels in the last 24 hours were established without quantum
protection (HNDLRisk=1). Traffic through these tunnels is vulnerable to harvest-now-decrypt-later
attacks. This is an adoption tracking signal — review which peers lack PQC support and prioritize
their upgrade to ML-KEM-768 hybrid key exchange.
properties.displayName: High harvest-now-decrypt-later risk rate across VPN tunnels
properties.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventType_s == "tunnel_up"
| summarize Total = count(), AtRisk = countif(HNDLRisk_d == 1) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| extend HNDLPct = round(100.0 * AtRisk / Total, 1)
| where HNDLPct > 30
| project TimeGenerated, Total, AtRisk, HNDLPct

properties.description: QCryptonPQCVPNOverlay Analytics Rule 4

properties.displayName: High harvest-now-decrypt-later risk rate across VPN tunnels

properties.description: TunnelRekeyStorm_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

An abnormally high number of session rekey events was detected for a peer within a short period.
While periodic rekeying is expected (every ~120 seconds by default), a spike may indicate network
instability, peer crashes and reconnects, or an attempt to exhaust KEM resources through repeated
handshakes. Investigate the peer and network path.
properties.displayName: Excessive tunnel rekeying on PQC VPN Overlay
properties.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventType_s == "tunnel_rekey"
| summarize RekeyCount = count() by PeerID_s, PeerAddress_s
| where RekeyCount > 20
| project PeerID_s, PeerAddress_s, RekeyCount
| order by RekeyCount desc

properties.description: QCryptonPQCVPNOverlay Analytics Rule 5

properties.displayName: Excessive tunnel rekeying on PQC VPN Overlay

properties.description: NewPeerWithoutPQC_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

A previously unseen peer was discovered and connected to the PQC VPN Overlay without post-quantum
key exchange. This peer is using classical WireGuard only and traffic is vulnerable to
harvest-now-decrypt-later. New peers should be provisioned with ML-KEM-768 hybrid key exchange
support from the start to ensure quantum-safe connectivity.
properties.displayName: New peer connected without PQC — quantum protection not available
properties.query:
let knownPeers = PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(2d) .. ago(1d))
| distinct PeerID_s;
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventType_s == "peer_discovered"
| where PQCUsed_d == 0
| where PeerID_s !in (knownPeers)
| project TimeGenerated, PeerID_s, PeerAddress_s, KeyExchange_s, PolicyMode_s, HNDLRisk_d

properties.description: QCryptonPQCVPNOverlay Analytics Rule 6

properties.displayName: New peer connected without PQC — quantum protection not available

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

Hybrid post-quantum WireGuard tunnel telemetry for Microsoft Sentinel. The QCrypton PQC VPN Overlay extends WireGuard with ML-KEM-768 key encapsulation and ML-DSA-65 digital signatures, providing quantum-resistant tunnels with backward compatibility. Ingests tunnel lifecycle events, PQC adoption metrics, HNDL risk indicators, classical fallback warnings, and policy enforcement decisions via the Codeless Connector Framework (RestApiPoller). Ships with 1 data connector, 6 analytic rules, workbook, and Teams-notification playbook.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

• Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework

Data Connectors: 1, Workbooks: 1, Analytic Rules: 6, Playbooks: 1
